summary: Graph database for storing and querying connected data with Cypher, offered self-hosted or as Aura cloud.
access_note: Aura API credentials (client ID/secret) available on all tiers incl. free; database queries use per-instance credentials.
blocker_note: Data access is per database instance with its own URL and credentials, not one account-level token; Aura API only manages instances.

evidence.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
The Query API allows to execute Cypher statements against a Neo4j server through HTTP requests.
The current version of the Aura API is v1
Neo4j MCP implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets applications connect to external data

notes: Basic auth for the Query API now confirmed from the Query API page example (Authorization: Basic). Bolt not read. Official MCP repo is github.com/neo4j/mcp (from search results, not opened).
